gateway.title: Gateway
gateway.proxyDesc: Route Electron and Gateway traffic through your local proxy client.
gateway.proxyServerHelp: The default proxy for all requests. Bare host:port values default to HTTP.
gateway.proxyHttpServerHelp: Advanced override for HTTP requests. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyHttpsServerHelp: Advanced override for HTTPS requests. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyAllServerHelp: Advanced fallback for SOCKS-capable clients and protocols such as Telegram. Leave blank to use Proxy Server.
gateway.proxyBypassHelp: Semicolon, comma, or newline separated hosts that should connect directly.
gateway.proxyRestartNote: Saving reapplies Electron networking and restarts the Gateway immediately. Regular Gateway restarts keep existing Telegram channel proxy values when proxy is disabled; save while disabled to clear them.

sandbox.title: Sandbox Control
sandbox.description: ClawX uses policy-light by default. Docker and SSH remain explicit strong-isolation providers, and missing Docker never blocks the default Gateway path.

developer.title: Developer
developer.consoleDesc: Access the native OpenClaw management interface
developer.consoleNote: Opens the Control UI with gateway token injected
developer.gatewayTokenDesc: Paste this into Control UI settings if prompted
developer.cliDesc: Copy a command to run OpenClaw without modifying PATH.
developer.doctorDesc: Run `openclaw doctor` and inspect the raw diagnostic output.
developer.doctorFixRunFailed: Failed to run OpenClaw doctor fix
developer.installDetail: This will create ~/.local/bin/openclaw. Ensure ~/.local/bin is on your PATH if you want to run it globally.

workModes.title: Work Modes
workModes.currentModeDesc: Choose the behavior preset for the active workspace session. This does not change permissions or grant tools.
workModes.noWorkspace: Choose a workspace before changing the work mode.
workModes.kitsDesc: Choose the artifact-focused kits each mode advertises to the runtime. These are capability hints only; runtime policy still decides actual tools.

kitDescriptions.reports: Draft, structure, and export reports and Word-style documents.
kitDescriptions.sheets: Read, clean, calculate, and summarize spreadsheets or CSV data.
kitDescriptions.slides: Create presentation outlines and editable PPTX decks.
kitDescriptions.pdf: Extract, summarize, preview, and package PDF artifacts.
kitDescriptions.research: Collect web/source material with citations and readable summaries.
kitDescriptions.website: Build and verify HTML/web artifacts with browser previews.
kitDescriptions.design: Shape visual artifacts, dashboards, and polished layouts.
kitDescriptions.ops: Handle lightweight daily writing, action items, and personal operations.

workModes.toolBundlesDesc: Choose which tool bundle labels each mode advertises to the runtime. These labels express intent only; runtime policy still decides actual tools.

workHeatGraph.title: Work heatmap
workHeatGraph.description: Local activity from recent session usage.
